prog='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for r in grid for c in r)
    sep=None
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if n==w and any(all(x==c for x in row) for row in grid):
            sep=('r',[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==c for x in row)][0]); break
    if sep is None:
        for c,n in cnt.items():
            if n==h and any(all(r[j]==c for r in grid) for j in range(w)):
                sep=('c',[j for j in range(w) if all(r[j]==c for r in grid)][0]); break
    kind,k=sep
    if kind=='r':
        L=grid[:k]; R=grid[k+1:]
    else:
        L=[r[:k] for r in grid]; R=[r[k+1:] for r in grid]
    palL=set(c for r in L for c in r); palR=set(c for r in R for c in r)
    S=(palL&palR).pop()
    return [[3 if a==b else S for a,b in zip(lr,rr)] for lr,rr in zip(L,R)]
'''
